svg.title: Three services share one Kawa gateway
svg.desc: Order service produces events. Shipping and billing consume them. All three connect through the central Kawa gateway, which applies access rules and maps the virtual topic orders to orders-v2. Two Kafka brokers illustrate routing into the cluster. White packets show client requests followed by broker requests, then outlined packets return through Kawa. Kafka continues to store the events. The layout is schematic.
svg.text: Publish and consume through a shared routing layer
Client topic orders → Kafka topic orders-v2
Kawa applies access rules and maps the topic name.
